annotation.title_clean: 工业和信息化部办公厅 国家发展改革委办公厅 农业农村部办公厅 商务部办公厅 国家能源局综合司关于开展2025年新能源汽车下乡活动的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Conducting the 2025 New Energy Vehicles to the Countryside Campaign
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 工业和信息化部办公厅; 国家发展改革委办公厅; 农业农村部办公厅; 商务部办公厅; 国家能源局综合司
annotation.summary_en: Chinese ministerial notice launching the 2025 campaign promoting new energy vehicles in rural areas through exhibitions, test drives, charging and financial services, and incentives. It mentions synergy with intelligent connected vehicle vehicle-road-cloud pilots, but is essentially consumption and industrial policy, not AI governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Organise 2025 NEV rural campaign with exhibitions and test drives in selected counties
Coordinate after-sales, charging, insurance and credit providers
Implement tax relief, trade-in and county charging infrastructure policies
Link with intelligent connected vehicle 'vehicle-road-cloud' pilots
CAAM and partners lead implementation; safety emergency plans required
